source_metadata.title: Effectiveness of Nirsevimab Against RSV and RSV-Related Events in Infants

issues.description: Main-text Results says post hoc RSV episodes had 0.12 fewer mean encounters with P=.001, while Supplemental Table S7 identifies −0.12 (95% CI −0.34 to 0.10) as the unadjusted difference and −0.37 (95% CI −0.60 to −0.15) as the adjusted difference paired with P=.001. Both source statements were preserved as separate atoms; no silent correction was made.

extraction_limitations: This is an observational retrospective cohort; ATOM extraction records reported associations and does not convert them into causal claims.
The article and supplement were treated as one publication identity; supplement-derived atoms retain supplement anchors and the supplement document hash.
No dose amount was attached to nirsevimab exposure atoms because individual dose amounts were not reported in the analyzed source material.
Atoms remain review_status=needs_review because no human verification step was supplied in this run.
